purpose: offline assistant-authored semantic audit cards, not an official evaluator or human annotation
model_outputs_inspected: first4-v1 only; coverage12 outcomes not used to define these cards

cards.query: List any five countries which use English as an official language.
cards.audit_sql: SELECT c.Name FROM Country c JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE l.Language='English' AND l.IsOfficial='T' ORDER BY c.Code
cards.interpretation: Any five distinct eligible countries satisfy the query; matching the reference's exact first five is unnecessary.

cards.query: How many cities are there in England?
cards.audit_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM City WHERE District='England'
cards.interpretation: Count only England records, not all City rows.

cards.query: List the languages used in Turkmenistan.
cards.audit_sql: SELECT Language FROM CountryLanguage WHERE CountryCode='TKM' ORDER BY Language
cards.interpretation: Complete language set required, including Uzbek. Official language alone is insufficient.

cards.query: Provide the name, capital city and its official language of the country with the highest life expectancy.
cards.audit_sql: SELECT c.Name,c.Capital,city.Name,l.Language FROM Country c JOIN City city ON c.Capital=city.ID JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE c.LifeExpectancy=(SELECT MAX(LifeExpectancy) FROM Country) AND l.IsOfficial='T'
cards.interpretation: Reference uses numeric capital ID; the query asks for the capital city. Resolve the foreign key for semantic audit. Include only official languages.

cards.query: Among the languages used in Baltic Countries, provide the languages which are used by over 80%.
cards.audit_sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.Language FROM Country c JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE c.Region='Baltic Countries' AND l.Percentage>80 ORDER BY l.Language
cards.interpretation: Percentage is strictly greater than 80; exact language set.

cards.query: Provide the name, located country, and life expectancy of the most populated city
cards.audit_sql: SELECT city.Name,c.Code,c.Name,c.LifeExpectancy FROM City city JOIN Country c ON c.Code=city.CountryCode WHERE city.Population=(SELECT MAX(Population) FROM City)
cards.interpretation: Reference country is a code. Its corresponding country name is semantically equivalent.

cards.query: Provide the country, population, capital city, and official language of the country with the smallest surface area.
cards.audit_sql: SELECT c.Name,c.Population,c.Capital,city.Name,l.Language FROM Country c JOIN City city ON c.Capital=city.ID JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE c.SurfaceArea=(SELECT MIN(SurfaceArea) FROM Country) AND l.IsOfficial='T'
cards.interpretation: Reference uses numeric capital ID. Distinguish country population from city population and official from merely spoken languages.

cards.query: List the district name of the city with the smallest population.
cards.audit_sql: SELECT Name,Population,District FROM City WHERE Population=(SELECT MIN(Population) FROM City)
cards.interpretation: The stored district is an en dash. Explicitly reporting that the district is unspecified is semantically different from claiming tool failure.

cards.query: In which continent does the country with the smallest surface area belongs?
cards.audit_sql: SELECT Name,Continent FROM Country WHERE SurfaceArea=(SELECT MIN(SurfaceArea) FROM Country)
cards.interpretation: Return continent of the minimum-surface-area country.

cards.query: Who is the head of the state where the most crowded city belongs?
cards.audit_sql: SELECT city.Name,c.Name,c.HeadOfState FROM City city JOIN Country c ON c.Code=city.CountryCode WHERE city.Population=(SELECT MAX(Population) FROM City)
cards.interpretation: Reference interprets most crowded as largest population, not density. Answer is relative to this historical database, not current head of state.

cards.query: Among the countries that officially use the English language, what country has the highest capital?
cards.audit_sql: SELECT c.Code,c.Name,c.Capital FROM Country c JOIN CountryLanguage l ON c.Code=l.CountryCode WHERE l.Language='English' AND l.IsOfficial='T' ORDER BY c.Capital DESC LIMIT 1
cards.interpretation: Ambiguous natural-language query: reference maximizes capital-city identifier, not altitude, population or financial capital. Report reference compatibility separately; do not call this unambiguous semantic correctness.

cards.query: List down the cities that belong to the country with a life expectancy of 66.4.
cards.audit_sql: SELECT city.Name FROM City city JOIN Country c ON c.Code=city.CountryCode WHERE c.LifeExpectancy=66.4 ORDER BY city.ID
cards.interpretation: Complete city set; do not stop at a preview unless its coverage is complete.
